$comment: gif-scene blocks that do not render today, grandfathered so ci:gif-scenes can gate NEW breakage without first fixing pre-existing debt (see the 2026-08-25 Linear Algebra GIF fix — 4 concepts were repaired and removed from this list; the 6 below are out of scope for that change and remain broken on purpose, matching demo/seed-media.ts's known 10-failure baseline minus the 4 fixed LA ones).
